purpose: minimal-token Astra review/integration packet for Aegis GitLab architecture

prs.purpose: single GitLab CE Rails runtime + supervision UI + GitLab MCP + Dagger
Ruby/Rust boundary; keep whole-Rails transpilation optional
optional deep GitHub website/control bridge while preserving self-hosting

invariants: GitLab CE/FOSS is the only Rails application
GitHub is optional and cannot be a boot/proof dependency
Dagger is execution/caching, never mathematical proof
prefer GitLab/Rails-native DSLs before adding new metaprogramming libraries
any Aegis macro/DSL that hides generated API surface must emit a machine-readable expansion/index
runtime process evidence cannot satisfy formal proof acceptance
review_questions: Does any new architecture alter or weaken the formalization/bootstrapping trust chain?
Are GitLab/Rails-native DSLs sufficient for the supervision surface before introducing an external DSL?
Does every metaprogrammed Aegis surface expose deterministic expansion metadata for human/agent review?
Can the GitHub bridge be removed/disabled without affecting local Aegis formalization or supervision?
expected_answer_shape: approve/revise individual invariants and named integration points; do not re-read unchanged implementation files unless a listed invariant fails
token_policy: review semantic deltas from ADRs/registry first; descend into code only for disputed claims or failing tests
